Flamengo beat Fluminense 1–0 at the Maracanã on Sunday (11) in Matchday 30 of the 2026 Brasileirão. Flamengo, with a deeper squad, made just three changes from their last match (a 2–2 draw with Santos). Against this backdrop, Flamengo dominated the Rio derby, pressing their rivals as they tried to play out from the back and allowing them to create very little. Lucas Paquetá crossed from the right, and Carrascal struck a fine first-time finish to beat goalkeeper Fábio.
